protocol_a: GA wall-clock matched to the exact solve (floor 5 s), restart-on-stagnation, equal-cost polish
protocol_b: GA given 1,000,000 evaluations, restart-on-stagnation, equal-cost polish
implementation_note: The GA is pure Python and the exact solver is compiled C++, so wall-clock matching favours the exact solver; protocol B reports the evaluation-budget view alongside it.
